jobs.title: Agricultural Equipment Technician
jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled technician to maintain and repair agricultural equipment. The ideal candidate should have experience with tractors, harvesters, and other farming machinery.

company.name: Punjab Agro Solutions
company.description: Punjab Agro Solutions is a leading provider of agricultural equipment and services, dedicated to supporting farmers in rural Punjab.

jobs.title: Village School Teacher
jobs.description: Join our team as a part-time teacher in a rural school. We are looking for passionate individuals to teach primary-level students and make a difference in their lives.

company.name: Rural Education Society
company.description: Rural Education Society is committed to providing quality education to children in underserved areas of Punjab.

jobs.title: Handicraft Trainer
jobs.description: We are seeking a trainer to teach women in rural areas how to create and sell handicrafts. Experience in traditional Punjabi crafts is preferred.

company.name: Punjab Handicrafts Initiative
company.description: Punjab Handicrafts Initiative empowers rural women by providing training and resources to create sustainable livelihoods.

jobs.title: Organic Farming Consultant
jobs.description: We are looking for an organic farming consultant to guide farmers in adopting sustainable agricultural practices. Knowledge of organic certification processes is a plus.

company.name: Green Punjab Farms
company.description: Green Punjab Farms is dedicated to promoting organic farming and sustainable agriculture in rural Punjab.

jobs.title: Rural Healthcare Worker
jobs.description: We are hiring healthcare workers to provide basic medical services in rural areas. Candidates with nursing or paramedical experience are encouraged to apply.

company.name: Punjab Rural Health Mission
company.description: Punjab Rural Health Mission aims to improve healthcare access and outcomes in underserved rural communities.

jobs.title: Dairy Farm Manager
jobs.description: We are seeking a manager to oversee daily operations at a dairy farm. Responsibilities include managing livestock, ensuring milk quality, and supervising workers.

company.name: Amrit Dairy Farms
